note: Text one player sends the others during a match. Messages players exchange outside a match do not travel on this connection at all.

fields.name: netId
fields.note: A network object the message concerns. Observed as zero.

fields.name: paramsLength
fields.note: How many bytes of the run that follows carry meaning.

fields.name: textLength
fields.note: The length of the text, counted in bytes and excluding the byte that ends it.

fields.name: params
fields.note: Always thirty two bytes, of which the length above says how many mean anything. A client leaves the rest as it found them, so they carry whatever the buffer last held and differ between two messages that are otherwise alike. A server reads no further than the stated length.

fields.name: text
fields.note: Every message observed carried text a single byte per character could hold, so nothing establishes how text outside that range is encoded.

fields.name: terminator
fields.note: A zero byte closing the text. Observed as zero.
